name: Scout's Banner
blurb: Scout's Banner has no fixed world spawns — it is a Season Scoreboard reward consumable. This guide covers what it does, how to obtain it, and any vendors, containers or events that hand it over.

consumption.note: Consuming Scout's Banner applies the effects below.

obtain.note: Scout's Banner is a Season Scoreboard reward consumable (datamined editor ID SCORE_Banner_Consumable) — it is handed out on the free reward track of the seasons that feature it, not found in the world. Deploy it in your CAMP or on an event to apply the Battle Banner team perks to nearby players. Check the current Season Scoreboard (and the Atom Shop, when a bundle includes it) for the live source.
